title: Achiri timeout handling — 30s Ollama timeout + faster error response
description: Achiri Ollama fetch has no explicit timeout, causing 5-minute waits when Ollama is down/slow. Add 30s AbortController timeout so users get error response quickly instead of waiting for Node's default 300s timeout.

tasks.title: Add 30s AbortController timeout to Ollama fetch in Achiri chat
